messages:
zia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance Q&A. A couple of teams asked for a compact "who approves what" and the expedite rules for infra during production incidents. Can we get a short playbook?

maria: Sure  TL;DR: runway guardrail target remains 18 months baseline. For approvals: p-card for small buys, PO/invoice for > $5k, capex/commits > $25k need FP&A+exec sign-off.

cfo_lee: One nuance: because of seasonal sales variability we recommend teams model a conservative runway at ~20 months in planning (FP&A will publish both 18m baseline + 20m conservative slides).

ops_kai: For production-impact infra: use procurement intake + flag "expedite:prod". We will fast-track within 24 business hours and can issue temporary credits or virtual cards for up to 60 days if needed. Anything recurring beyond 60 days needs procurement+legal+finance review.

eng_ana: Timeline question: if we submit an SOW today, what is realistic turnaround for legal+procurement?

procurement_amy: Typical SLA: intake triage 2 business days, straightforward SOW 7-10 business days, security reviews add time. For expedited prod-impact flows state the incident ID + business impact and we aim to return an approval path within 48 hours.

zia: Can we get an approval matrix snippet we can paste into PRDs?

maria: Yep. Paste-friendly matrix (one-liner rows):
- p-card: single txn <= $2k, default monthly cap $5k
- virtual card: manager+finance approval up to $15k one-off (audit caveat)
- PO/invoice: > $5k standard path
- capex/commits: > $25k FP&A + exec review; > $75k requires procurement+legal kick-off early

eng_ana: Nice. Any changes to monthly card caps by role?

maria: No global changes today. Defaults: IC monthly cap $1k, Manager $5k, Eng Ops $10k. Temporary increases allowed with VP+Finance sign-off for up to 30 days.

cfo_lee: On vendor terms: procurement leads negotiation; finance approves cash-impact. For strategic vendors we will pursue net-60 or milestone payments to smooth cash. Procurement will also start quarterly vendor consolidation reviews to reduce overlap.

ops_kai: Small operational item: please ensure all cloud reservations have a cost-center tag and a short PRD row showing expected utilization. This helps FP&A amortize capex properly.

procurement_amy: Also: if a vendor only accepts card and amount > $5k, procurement prefers requesting an invoice. If not possible, we can issue a virtual card after manager+finance approvals; avoid for > $20k where possible due to audit noise.

zia: Can we get a single one-page flowchart and a 1-paragraph FAQ for engineering leads?

maria: Action: procurement to publish a 1-page "procurement playbook" (flowchart + 1-paragraph FAQ) by Wed EOD. FP&A to publish 18m vs 20m runway slides + sensitivity waterfall by Fri.

finance-bot: New ticket created: PROC-499 - "Procurement playbook + runway slides" (assigned to procurement).

eng_ana: One last thing  will there be any stricter review for renewals/contractors during the scenario planning window?

cfo_lee: Renewals under $50k/yr continue with manager+finance signoff. Renewals >= $50k/yr require VP+Procurement review and alternatives analysis. Contractors treated like headcount for approvals during slowdowns.

zia: Perfect  I'll forward to Eng leads and add the matrix to our PRD template. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
